newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: Rice prices in the southern United States were steady to lower in the week ended June 28, USDA Market News said in its weekly review.

Long grain milled rice prices sold mostly at $20.00-21.00 per cwt.; Medium grain traded mostly at $18.50-19.00; Second heads were steady to 50 cents lower and Brewers were uneven, mostly steady. Rice by-products were uneven with tight supplies and light demand, USDA said.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly from $18.00-19.00, second heads were steady to 50 cents lower, and bran was $6.00 lower.

Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending June 28, there were 230,375 cwt of medium grain milled rice inspected. The yearly total since October 1, 1996, was 9,706,850 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
